messages.text:
No—your cancelled card does not stop the refund. It must still go to the original payment; the card issuer handles the credit, and the shop cannot promise where or when it appears. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Your rug refund proposal is **BRL 55.00**. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a typed “yes” does not confirm it. A staff member must then approve it before payment. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
